tytul: Dried cornelian cherries for tea: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for drying cornelian cherries: JarAtlas has no recipe for them from a checked source.

ostrzezenia.tekst: If the temperature is too low at the beginning of drying, microorganisms may survive and even grow before the food is adequately dried.

akapity: Cornelian cherries are not in the drying tables JarAtlas uses, so there is no checked drying time for them.
Home dehydrators are designed to dry food quickly at 140 °F (60 °C).
